## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes
- [ ] Ran `bun run catalog:build` if entries changed
- [ ] New scripts pass `shellcheck`, are dry-run or read-only by default, and have a test
- [ ] New entries are rated honestly and record `platforms`, `requires`, and `overlap`
- [ ] Vendored content was read in full and left unmodified
- [ ] Lasting design choices are recorded in `docs/decisions.md`
